title: GreekMMLU: A Native-Sourced Multitask Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in Greek
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of Orthodox Christian hymnology within a 'World Religions' subject category.
findings: The paper evaluates model performance on a 'World Religions' task, which specifically tests knowledge of Orthodox Christian hymnology. However, it does not provide specific analysis or findings for this religious category, instead grouping it within the broader 'Humanities' domain for performance reporting and high-level analysis.
